focus: security, token handling, untrusted release metadata, path construction, and read-to-write error boundaries

findingDetails.title: MCP preflight sends bearer token with TLS verification disabled
findingDetails.claim: The MCP preflight example can transmit the bearer token to an environment-selected endpoint with TLS verification disabled.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the default endpoint and the surrounding trust guidance; the default is loopback, but BASE_URL is overrideable and the example ignores the verification setting.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The example is intended only for a local self-signed REST API, so the operator may never set a remote endpoint.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: The example restricts the endpoint to trusted loopback or honors an explicit verification setting before sending the token.

findingDetails.title: Manifest ID is not validated before path construction
findingDetails.claim: Untrusted manifest.id data can influence a write path outside the intended plugin directory.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked quoting, manifest presence/version checks, and the troubleshooting contract; quoting prevents shell splitting but does not prevent path traversal.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Official Obsidian plugin manifests normally use a simple identifier, so the risk requires a malicious or compromised release.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Validate the manifest ID against the accepted plugin-ID grammar and assert the resolved destination remains below the selected vault plugin root.

findingDetails.title: Catch-all MCP read error can flow into a write
findingDetails.claim: The MCP round-trip example can write after a non-404 read failure and lose existing content or create an unintended note.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the surrounding comments and later tool verification steps; no status/error discriminator is present before the write.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The MCP wrapper may expose only 404 as a thrown exception in the intended runtime, but the code does not establish that contract.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Handle only a confirmed not-found response as an empty note and rethrow or stop on auth, transport, and server errors.

results.notes: BRAT scenario exposes the same untrusted path boundary.

title: Human resource-loading index omits newer plugin references
claim: The human-facing resource-loading index omits six plugin/theme reference sets that the executable router supports.
